registration_note: The rules were written before any backtest in this session. G11 is recorded as passed for that reason, and the git history shows the order.

gates.name: Sample floor
gates.test: At least 300 graded decisions in the holdout window.

gates.name: Hit rate over break-even
gates.test: Hit rate must exceed the break-even implied by -110 on every leg.

gates.name: Two-sided significance
gates.test: p below 0.05 against the break-even rate.

gates.name: Multiple-comparison control
gates.test: Benjamini-Hochberg q at 0.05 across every registered strategy.

gates.name: Holdout only
gates.test: Evaluated on the frozen holdout; nothing refitted on it.

gates.name: Placebo / matched-random control
gates.test: Must beat 95% of matched random selections of the same size.

gates.name: Season stability
gates.test: Above break-even in at least 60% of seasons with 20+ decisions.

gates.name: Threshold robustness
gates.test: Must survive moving the threshold one step.

gates.name: Cluster-aware interval
gates.test: Week-clustered bootstrap interval must exclude break-even.

gates.name: No look-ahead
gates.test: Every forecast input must predate kickoff (perturbation test).

gates.name: Pre-registration
gates.test: Configuration frozen and recorded before the holdout was evaluated.

gates.name: Prospective replication
gates.test: Timestamped forward predictions; not yet available.

definitions.name: Spread divergence >= 2.0 points
definitions.rule: Bet the side where the own line differs from the third-party closing line by 2+ points.

definitions.name: Spread divergence >= 3.5 points
definitions.rule: Same rule, wider threshold; fewer bets, larger disagreement.

definitions.name: Total divergence >= 2.0 points
definitions.rule: Bet over when the own total is 2+ above the closing total, under when 2+ below.

definitions.name: Rest advantage >= 3 days
definitions.rule: Bet the side with 3+ more days of rest.

definitions.name: Short-week fade of the road team
definitions.rule: Bet the home team when the visitor played 4 or fewer days earlier.

definitions.name: Wind >= 15 mph: under
definitions.rule: Bet the under in outdoor games with wind of 15 mph or more.

definitions.name: Divisional home underdog getting 1-3 points
definitions.rule: Bet a divisional home underdog with a handicap between 1 and 3 points.

definitions.name: Large home underdog
definitions.rule: Bet a home underdog getting 7.0 points or more.

definitions.name: Both clubs out of a bye: under
definitions.rule: Bet the under when both clubs had 13+ days of rest.

definitions.name: Home underdog with a rest advantage
definitions.rule: Home underdog getting 3+ points with at least 2 more rest days than the visitor.

definitions.name: Big total divergence >= 5.0 points
definitions.rule: The same rule as S3 at a wider threshold; isolates extreme disagreements.

definitions.name: Cross-game 2-leg parlay from the top-2 spread edges of a week
definitions.rule: Legs are the two largest spread disagreements that week, from different games.

definitions.name: Cross-game 3-leg parlay from the top-3 spread edges of a week
Same-game 2-leg: spread + total on the same game
definitions.rule: The largest spread disagreement and the total disagreement on that same game.

definitions.name: QB passing yards over the own line
definitions.rule: Own line is the mean of the player's earlier official games this season.

definitions.name: WR receiving yards over the own line
RB rushing yards over the own line
Same-player prop combo: QB + his WR, same game
definitions.rule: Two legs on the same club; the dependency is measured, not assumed.

definitions.name: Cross-club prop combo (control)
definitions.rule: Two legs from different clubs: the dependency should be near zero, which is the point.
